abstract.para: Register the product in the Registration screen.

textobject.phrase: Screenshot of the &agama; installer for &productname; &productnumber; showing the registration page. It features input fields for selecting the registration server, entering a registration code, and providing an optional email address.

topic.para: Choose a registration server and enter the details:

listitem.para: Register with the &scc;. If your system is behind a firewall, make sure &sccurl; is reachable from your network.
Register with your own &smlm; or &rmt; infrastructure and provide the Server URL. Use this option for air-gapped environments.
Enter a valid registration code for &productname;. The code is hidden by default but can be shown by clicking on the eye icon.
Optionally, enter a valid e-mail address. For organizations, we recommend using the address assigned to the registration code.

topic.para: Click Register to register the system.

section.title: Registering extensions
section.para: After successfully registering the base system, you can register additional extensions. The following extensions are available for &productname; &productnumber;:

listitem.para: The &sleha; extension provides mature, industry-leading open source high-availability clustering technologies that are easy to set up and use. You can deploy it in physical environments, virtual environments or both. It clusters physical servers, virtual servers or any combination of the two to suit the needs of your business.
To register your &sleha; extension, enter its registration code and click Register.

&ph; is a free module providing access to community-maintained packages built to run on &productname;. Built from the same sources used in &osuse; distributions, these quality packages provide additional software to what is found in &productname;. The packages in this module are delivered without L3 support but do not interfere with the supportability of &productname;.
To register with the &ph;, click Register. When the installer asks whether to trust the signing key of the &ph; repository, click Trust.
